title: Non-object JSON records escape parser error handling
reasoning: JSON decoding can successfully return a list, scalar, or null, but all three entry points immediately call .get without validating that the result is a dictionary. Such records raise AttributeError outside the existing JSON error handling. In particular, artifact detection can crash instead of returning false, and trajectory parsing exposes an incidental exception instead of its contextual ParseError.
reproduction: Supply a JSONL record containing null or [] to parse_line, can_parse, or parse. Each attempts .get on a non-dictionary value.
recommendation: Validate decoded records as objects before accessing event fields. Have detection reject unsupported records, streaming parsing handle them consistently with invalid input, and trajectory parsing raise ParseError with the line number.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: No tests were included; coverage for syntactically valid JSON with an invalid event shape could not be checked.
suggestedRegressionTest: Exercise object, array, string, number, boolean, and null records across the parser entry points, asserting their intended rejection behavior and contextual errors.
minimumFixScope: The JSON decoding boundaries in PiAgent.parse_line, PiParser.can_parse, and PiParser.parse.
